bio: Slices of Mediterranean dentex served raw, caraway, cauliflower and elderberry vinegar; Camargue bull, oyster tartare from the Étang de Thau and salicornia-pistachio pesto: there's no doubt that chef Jérôme Faure has a masterful understanding of gourmet cuisine. His subtly innovative take on fine dining is based on a rigorous selection of local ingredients. The same goes for the wines....
